truth.description: The matcher createSingleIsIgnoredFunction returns now resolves the path it checks against the ignore file's folder instead of the working directory, but formatStdin still hands it the --stdin-filepath value relative to the working directory through createIsIgnoredFromContextOrDie, so with --ignore-path ../.prettierignore a stdin file that the ignore file lists is formatted instead of printed as-is.

distractions.why: With no ignore file at all, one matcher with no file still has to be built so node_modules stays ignored, and that matcher is only needed when --with-node-modules is off.
